[binaries]
c = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-clang'
cpp = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-clang++'
ar = 'llvm-ar'
strip = 'llvm-strip'
windres = 'x86_64-w64-mingw32-windres'
c_ld = 'lld'
cpp_ld = 'lld'

[properties]
needs_exe_wrapper = true

[host_machine]
system = 'windows'
cpu_family = 'x86_64'
cpu = 'x86_64'
endian = 'little'

[built-in options]
c_args = ['-march=x86-64-v3', '-mtune=znver3', '-O3', '-fomit-frame-pointer']
cpp_args = ['-march=x86-64-v3', '-mtune=znver3', '-O3', '-fomit-frame-pointer']
c_link_args = ['-fuse-ld=lld']
cpp_link_args = ['-fuse-ld=lld']
